brandForm.title: New campaign
brandForm.subtitle: 6 questions, 2 minutes. Your budget stays in escrow: the creator is only paid after you approve.
brandForm.sectorHint: We prefill the text for you. No prices.
brandForm.countHint: Each creator delivers the quantity above.
brandForm.cityHint: The city where the content is shot.
brandForm.advancedToggle: Enter the net pay per creator instead
brandForm.payoutHint: The total budget is computed to cover each creator after the fee.
brandForm.belowFloorHint: Below the minimum Bayele recommends for this content ({floor} per unit): you may get few applications.
brandForm.floorAck: I understand creators may not apply
brandForm.rightsHint: Where and for how long you can use the content.
brandForm.titleHint: Leave empty: we build it from your answers.
brandForm.messagePlaceholder: The message to get across, the tone, the do's and don'ts…
brandForm.visibilityPublicHint: Shareable link + search engines. Anyone can see it.
brandForm.footnote: The campaign is saved as a draft. It goes live as soon as the Mobile Money payment is confirmed.

errors.required: Answer the 6 questions to create the campaign.
errors.budget: The budget must be enough to pay each creator.
errors.floorAck: Tick the box to confirm you've read the pay warning.
errors.generic: Creation failed. Check the amounts and try again.

briefs.title: Managed briefs
briefs.subtitle: Briefs received by WhatsApp or phone: from draft to funded listing.

empty.title: No managed briefs yet
empty.body: When a brand sends its brief on WhatsApp, create it here: the form follows the listing standard, computes the net pay and prepares the order form.
empty.unavailable: Managed briefs are not available on this database yet (migration 0033 not applied).

editor.resendNotice: Listing changed after the order form was sent: the brief is back to draft. Send the order form again to get a new "YES".

template.title: Start from a template
template.confirm: This template replaces the service, deliverables, profile and rights already entered.

brand.internalNameHint: Legal or trade name, for the order form. Never shown.
brand.contactWhatsappHint: International format, e.g. +237 6XX XX XX XX.
brand.label: Public label
brand.labelHintDescriptor: Describe the business without the city (it's shown next to it). Never use another company's name.
brand.labelHintReal: The exact name the brand agreed to have published.
brand.consentHint: A screenshot of the WhatsApp "OK" is enough. Without consent, use a descriptor: the listing always shows "Managed by Bayele".
brand.consentProofHint: E.g. WhatsApp screenshot of 12/10, saved in the client folder.
brand.labelEqualsName: Without consent, the public label can't reuse the brand's name.

service.title: Listing title (optional)
service.titleHint: Leave empty to reuse the service.

deliv.mainHint: The deliverable that costs the most to produce. The others go in the detail.
deliv.detailHint: Everything that will be delivered: formats, durations, what to show, do's and don'ts. Members only.
deliv.disclosureHint: The "#ad" disclosure is required on sponsored posts.
deliv.claimsHint: Sensitive category (real estate, finance, health): tick only once you've checked the evidence for the brand's claims (price, yield, effects…).

deadline.label: Delivery deadline
deadline.hint: Latest delivery date, the one on the order form.

budget.totalHint: 25% Bayele fee included — the amount the brand pays.
budget.plan: Agency plan · 25% — fixed for managed campaigns.

pay.shownOnListing: This is the amount shown on the listing.
pay.incomplete: Enter the budget and the number of spots.

floor.undefinedBody: No floor is set for this deliverable: publishing is allowed.
floor.optionScope: Same budget: {qty} per spot instead of {current}
floor.blocked: Below the pay floor: send a counter-offer.
floor.unknown: Floors unavailable: the server will check on publish.

rights.label: Usage rights
rights.customPlaceholder: Where, for how long, paid ads or not…
rights.keep: The creator keeps authorship and can show the content in their portfolio.

profile.requirementsHint: What matters to succeed: style, experience, on-camera language. No physical or age criteria.
profile.equipmentHint: Only if essential — otherwise leave empty.

application.text: Apply through Bayele with a creator account. Bayele proposes 2 to 3 creators per spot; the brand approves within 48 h (no reply: Bayele picks).

order.proofHint: E.g. screenshot of the WhatsApp "YES", 12/10 at 10:14

payment.refHint: Enter the MTN, Orange, Wave… receipt or SokoClick invoice reference in Funding. Never just a screenshot.

publish.explain: Publishing takes 2 steps. 1. The campaign is created, invisible on Bayele. 2. Once the payment has arrived, you confirm the funding in Funding with the receipt reference: the campaign goes live and creators are notified in the app.
publish.readOnly: The listing has been created. To change it before funding, decline this brief and duplicate it.
publish.step2Body: The campaign exists but stays invisible until the funding is confirmed.
publish.needChecklist: Complete the "Before publishing" list to publish.
publish.republish: The previous campaign was cancelled: this brief can be published again.

decline.cancelsCampaign: The created (unfunded) campaign will be cancelled.

notes.label: Internal notes
notes.hint: Never shown. History of exchanges, nudges, counter-offers.

manual.label: Manual status
manual.hint: Only Draft, Waiting for "YES" and Declined can be set by hand; payment and publishing update automatically.

payFloors.title: Pay floors
payFloors.body: The minimum net amount a creator must receive per delivered unit, after Bayele's fee. Finance and Community will set these floors from Bayele's real data. Until a floor is set for a deliverable type, managed campaigns of that type can be published.
payFloors.unavailable: Pay floors are not available on this database yet (migration 0033 not applied).
payFloors.confirmSet: Managed campaigns of this type can no longer be published below {value} per unit. Campaigns already published don't change.
payFloors.confirmRemove: Without a floor, publishing is allowed whatever the amount.
